en-US.title: Zoff
en-US.subtitle: Shared music rooms
en-US.description:
Create or join a shared music room and listen together. Add songs from enabled music providers, vote on what should play next, control playback, cast to a larger screen, or pair your phone as a remote for another Zoff player.

Zoff keeps the room queue and playback state synchronized while each provider plays through its official embedded player and controls.
en-US.promoText: Shared music rooms, made for listening together.
